meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude设计网页界面时，先明确主题、受众和页面单一目标，再定制配色、字体、布局和标志性元素，避免模板化，并推敲界面文案。
howto.when: 当用户请求新建界面、重塑现有界面，或询问视觉方向、排版建议时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个有独特风格的网页。
say.note: 它会先明确主题和受众再设计。

say.text: 这个界面太模板了，换个设计方向。
say.note: 它会按设计原则提出新方案。

say.text: 为一款咖啡品牌设计主页视觉。
say.note: 它会给出配色、字体和布局方案。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude first pin down the subject, audience, and single page goal, then craft a custom palette, typography, layout, and signature element, avoid templated defaults, and write intentional interface copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build new UI, reshape an existing UI, or requests visual direction or typography advice.

say_en.text: Help me design a web page with a distinctive style.
say_en.note: It will first clarify the subject and audience before designing.

say_en.text: This interface looks too templated, give it a different design direction.
say_en.note: It will propose a new plan based on design principles.

say_en.text: Design a homepage visual for a coffee brand.
say_en.note: It will provide color, typography, and layout options.
